The answer to the Fermi Paradox is the Great Filter

I produced an EP based on the the Great Silence/Great Filter (wrapped in a wink to simulation theory) just about 10 years ago. It was ~20 min improvised noise set that was recorded live and never played again. That's all I have to add to this.

The problem with this is it always assumes all possible intelligent life in the universe has a similar history, behavior and technological capacity as Earth humans. Just as we always assume life is carbon-based and requires water we assume other beings would develop the same way we do. Maybe the universe is teaming with life that we just do not recognize because we are ourselves too different and unwilling to expand our definition of what life and intelligence could be.

The thing is that the great filter can be anything. It doesn't have to mean that civilizations have to go extinct. Say the human race somehow doesn't drive itself into extinction by nuking ourselves, or destroying the planet. Even after thousands of years of advancement, we might not have the right stuff to think outside of the box and really take off this planet or leave the solar system. And even if we do get to that stage, it may be impossible to actually go anywhere in the universe. Yeah we can spend a few centuries or millennia traveling to local star systems, but there might be an upper limit on that, and we could very likely hit a hard cap on how fast we can spread and where. Or it could be something completely different that we're not even aware of.

I would guess that the "great filter" would be whether or not a species can develop to the point of being able to create a indefinitely self-sustaining livable location off-planet without committing complete self destruction. Since it's far simpler to destroy than to create, and the fundamental driving force of life, improvement, and convenience is greed and laziness it's far easier to have a manmade apocalypse and technological stagnation than to actually create off-planet colonies that can survive for the foreseeable future, as greed begets conflict, and large scale conflict only becomes simpler and simpler to have take place as we create more and more devastating weapons.
Dinosaurs were around for about 100 million years and, as far as we know, never evolved a higher intelligence. Perhaps THAT was the Great Filter.
